subject: C06
required_fixes: C06-A02-RF01 [P2] Preserve uncertainty and partial effects during avatar replacement. crates/desktop-core/src/academy.rs:565 collapses lost PUT replies and HTTP failures into UploadFailed; authority/learner_domain.rs:968 returns Rejected for every failed/cancelled PUT, and :978 also treats a refused confirmation as rejection of the whole upload. However, Academy's pinned server/services/avatar.ts uses the stable avatars/{userId}.{ext} key: overwriting an existing avatar changes its publicly served bytes before confirmAvatar. A store can accept the bytes and lose its reply, or confirmation can fail after a successful overwrite. The desktop then reports 'Your photo is unchanged; try again' (use-avatar-upload.ts:90), with no readback. An independent in-memory execution of the actual synthetic store reproduced changed public bytes after a lost PUT response without confirmation; actual hostAction/useAvatarUpload code mapped the supplied native Rejected result to that unchanged claim and zero settings refreshes. Acceptance: distinguish pre-upload refusals/known rejection from uncertain PUT outcomes and effects already applied before failed confirmation. Report possible/partial changes truthfully, support appropriate readback even when the stored avatar URL has not changed, and do not automatically resend mutations. Add production-interface tests for an existing avatar overwritten before a lost PUT reply, cancellation/server failure after dispatch, and successful PUT followed by denied confirmation, including the composed learner message/readback.

C06-A02-RF02 [P2] Restore bounded image preparation and validate decodable photos. apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/adapters.rs:337 limits the selected source file directly to Academy's 2 MiB upload cap; crates/desktop-core/src/avatar.rs:48-66 checks only leading bytes and AvatarJob uploads the original file unchanged. The pinned working-v1 baseline 74754c02 (src/ui/academy/profile_media.rs:187-239) accepts source photos up to 16 MiB, bounds decoding to 8192 pixels/128 MiB, applies orientation, and crops/re-encodes a 512-pixel square below the 2 MiB upload cap. Consequently ordinary 2-16 MiB photos that worked in v1 are rejected, while truncated JPEG/PNG/WebP headers can be uploaded and confirmed as broken avatars. Current tests explicitly accept such non-images; the Rust integration 'png' contains a signature followed by text. Acceptance: implement bounded native decoding/preparation with the retained source-photo capability, orientation and square output, keeping Academy's final upload cap and credential/destination restrictions. Test real decodable larger source photos, orientation/output dimensions, malformed files retaining valid magic bytes, and decoder dimension/allocation limits; invalid images must cause no upload.
optional_suggestions: crates/desktop-core/tests/academy_program/main.rs:230 still supplies obsolete runId/alertId/choice inputs to shift.answer and runId to shift.serve. Align this scheduling fixture with the actual shiftId/order/values and shiftId/order contracts. The native C06-N06 evidence already uses the correct shape, so this remains optional.

Consider exposing a load-failed state from useLearnerImage. When the native loader returns null, Settings receives no src and silently shows initials, so AvatarUploadHero's image-error message cannot explain that an existing photo could not be read.
